Every factual claim the draft makes was re-derived independently: all six measured-input digests reproduce, both frozen verdicts are ACCEPT with 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX and three advisories each at mode 0444 with the Codex lane parsed directly rather than taken on the draft's word, the condition-2 arithmetic of 4 of 30 was recomputed from file 08's Status column, DR-105 is confirmed OPEN, condition 5 is confirmed last and NOT MET, all 28 decisions in the same-form set are ADOPTED including the newly added D-093, D-126 does not already exist in COORD, and the decision-versus-row distinction is correct in both directions. All six advisories are recorded rather than dropped, which was a named attack. One asymmetry in the item-6 enumeration survives as an advisory on the same reasoning I applied at D-125, where the identical pattern was consented to and adopted. I record one limit plainly: my own ACCEPT record in this lineage is 0 for 3, and this verdict certifies the fidelity of the recording, not the correctness of the verdict it records.
